title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: After the car door closes
hook: What happens in the car after your games?
intro: You finish your talk with the team.
Then parents take over on the drive home.
statement: Kids need one coach, and parents need a different role.
q1: Do you suggest parents keep car rides positive —
q2: or stay out of what happens after the game?
q3: What do your players hear on the way home?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids enjoy the game more
t2: when the ride home is not a second review.
cta: Coaches — do you talk to parents about the ride home?
ctaLines: Say I loved watching you play. Ask what was fun.
Bring it up or leave it?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What happens in the car after your games?
You finish your talk with the team. Then parents take over on the drive home.
Kids need one coach, and parents need a different role.
Bring it up with parents or leave it alone. Every team is different.
Do you talk to parents about the ride home? Share your habit in the comments.
